nations.name: Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma
also: Absentee-Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma
nations.lands: central Oklahoma, including the Shawnee and Little Axe areas

facts.text: The Tribe's own history connects its 'absentee' name to groups absent from the signing of an 1854 treaty for a Kansas reservation.

source.title: About Us | Absentee Shawnee Tribe
source.publisher: Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma

facts.evidence: not present at the signing of the 1854 treaty

facts.text: The Tribe's government page describes separate Legislative/Executive and Judicial branches, alongside an independent Election Commission.

source.title: Government | Absentee Shawnee Tribe
source.publisher: Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma

facts.evidence: two separate branches, the Legislative/Executive Branch and the Judicial Branch

facts.text: The Historic Preservation Department dates the Tribe's Tribal Historic Preservation Office status to 2004, following an application in 2002.

source.title: Historic Preservation | Absentee Shawnee Tribe
source.publisher: Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma

facts.evidence: By 2004, the Tribe was granted THPO status

facts.text: The Tribe's language page lists a lexicon and online lessons among its resources; the index does not establish access conditions or teaching availability.

source.title: Language | Absentee Shawnee Tribe
source.publisher: Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma
